item.title: You Can Check If Pants Fit Using Your Neck?!
item.description: No fitting room? Try wrapping the waistband of your pants around your neck! If the ends meet comfortably, the waist might fit. It's a handy sizing trick, but it doesn't work for everyone!

item.title: My backyard would have been WAY different if I hadn’t gone for it on Facebook Marketplace! Now with Facebook Verified, I don’t have to spend hours researching sellers, or pass on things that I really need. The Verified badge tells me right away that there is a real person behind the profile. One less thing to worry about - though I am still going to pause since I need to ask my wife if it’s the right “look” for what we need.

item.title: You Can Knock the Core Right Out of Lettuce?!
item.description: Struggling to remove the core from iceberg lettuce? Give the stem end a firm smack against a sturdy countertop, then twist and pull the core right out! A surprisingly easy kitchen trick.
